hero.promise3: , and pay a fraction of the cost.

workflow.title: Stop paying AI to grep your codebase.
workflow.subtitle1: Agentic slot-machines burn your quotas reading 500 irrelevant files just to change a CSS class.
workflow.subtitle2: With Frugäast, you define the exact boundary. It reads what you explicitly select, and nothing else.

imageBefore.alt: Before: Expensive Agentic Loop spinning out of control

imageAfter.alt: After: Frugäast's precise file selection and instant execution

different.subtitle: Tired of babysitting autonomous agents that rewrite your tests to hide their bugs?

cleanCode.title: Say goodbye to AI slop.
cleanCode.para1_1: Yes, frontier models boast 1M+ token context windows.
cleanCode.para1_2: But dump your whole repo in, and watch them suffer from context rot, amnesia, and extreme over-engineering.
cleanCode.para2: Frugäast keeps your context lean. Send only the files that matter, and get surgically precise SEARCH/REPLACE blocks applied directly via Git.

features.title: Lightning-fast context curation.
features.desc1: Ultra-fast fuzzy search to build your exact context.
features.desc2: A clean left-sidebar treeview ensures no hidden files slip in.

features.title: One prompt. One deterministic edit.
features.desc1: No "Let me think about this" loops. You prompt, it executes the code blocks, you review.

features.title: No hallucinated architecture.
features.desc1: Protect your core abstractions. The LLM fixes the code you gave it,
features.desc2: it doesn't try to rewrite your entire SaaS.

image.alt: Comparison showing a massive 2000-line messy AI PR versus a clean, 15-line Frugäast surgical edit

costControl.title: End the token-burning slot machine.
costControl.para1_1: Autonomous agentic loops quietly consume 100K+ tokens while they poll themselves, apologize to you, and spawn unnecessary sub-agents.
costControl.para1_2: Frugäast is strictly BYOK (Bring Your Own Key). No $200/mo limits, no hidden downgrades to cheaper models, and no opaque rate caps.
costControl.para1_3: You pay exactly for what you prompt, at base API costs. Period.

features.title: Zero "polling" waste.
features.desc: Stop paying for the AI to talk to itself. Frugäast cuts the multi-agent messaging overhead to absolute zero.

features.title: Use the model you actually want.
features.desc: Easily copy your context to the clipboard for web chats, or use the API. No vendor lock-in.

features.title: Radical token transparency.
features.desc: A built-in dashboard tracks the exact API cost of every project, file, and specific edit.

image.alt: Dashboard showing completely transparent, extremely low API costs compared to an exhausted $200 subscription limit

philosophy.title: For engineers, not vibe-coders.
philosophy.para1: You know your architecture. You know where the bug is. You don't need a black-box AI playing CTO and destroying your database schema in the process.
philosophy.para2: Frugäast is built for senior developers who want an incredibly fast pair of hands—not a junior dev that needs constant supervision.

image.alt: An experienced developer pointing exactly to the specific files needed for an edit, ignoring the noise of the rest of the codebase

cta.title: Start coding with intention.
cta.subtitle1: Open your existing codebase, fuzzy-search the exact files you want to edit,
cta.subtitle2: and let Frugäast handle the boilerplate.
cta.subtitle3: No agents. No hallucinations. Just clean, controlled, and frugal edits.
